selectionRationale: The user-provided side-by-side Messenger and BUKLOD screenshots, plus current source markup, show oversized redundant header/encouragement and empty Notes rails delaying conversation display. A search-first layout removes the actual root cause while retaining monetization and existing routing.
alternativeApproaches: Reduce only margins and keep the large hero banner (rejected because an extra UI block would still displace chat and Wall content).
Remove Notes or ads entirely (rejected because this breaks established social/monetization features).
Use one compact search-first surface with dynamic Notes and existing advertising integration (selected).
